  • Strait of Hormuz
    • US, Iran and Oman are disputing the fine print of a proposed Hormuz access deal. Tactical: delay in agreement keeps shipping uncertainty and sanction-leverage active.
    • Iran continues selective passage policy (Russia, India, China allowed; others blocked). Risk of targeted closures or inspections remains.
  • Northern Border
    • Jerusalem Post: Israel and Lebanon adopted a 'trust, but verify' agreement. Tactical: adds verification mechanisms to reduce immediate escalation, but Hezbollah remains active daily.
  • Media/Other
    • Al Jazeera: Iran urged FIFA over World Cup treatment. Low operational relevance.
  • 🟢 Good News: A 10‑day pause was announced and a verification-focused Israel‑Lebanon deal was adopted — both reduce short-term escalation risk.
  • Threat assessment: escalating

  • מצר הורמוז
    • ארה"ב, איראן ועומאן מתעמתות על נוסחי הסכם הגישה למיצר. טקטי: עיכוב בהסכמה משאיר חוסר וודאות בנמלים ובנתיבי הסחר.
    • איראן ממשיכה מדיניות מעבר סלקטיבית (רוסיה, הודו, סין מותרות; אחרות נחסמות). קיים סיכון לסגירות או בדיקות ממוקדות.

Situation Brief — Day 27 (last 2 hours)

  • Attacks & pauses
    • Trump announced SECOND pause on Iran energy strikes: 10 days, deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET. Claimed “Iranian Government request” and talks “going very well.”
    • Iran denies direct talks. Tactical note: first 5‑day pause (Mar 23) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr — pause fragile.
    • IDF reports targeted strike killed Wadi Haniyeh, nephew of Hamas leader Ismail Haniyeh.
  • Northern border — Lebanon / Hezbollah
    • New Israel‑Lebanon framework adopted. Israeli leadership calls it a strategic blow to the Iranian axis; described as “trust, but verify.”
    • Hezbollah declared the agreement ‘null and void’ and warned of civil unrest. Tactical: daily Hezbollah activity continues — deconfliction fragile.
  • Strait of Hormuz & maritime
    • US, Iran and Oman disputing fine print of a Hormuz access deal.
    • Iran is selectively allowing passage for friendly states (Russia, India, China) while restricting others — raises targeting/inspection risk for commercial shipping.
  • Airspace & movements
    • Flight scan: multiple airports reported closed across the region (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan). Expect continued civil aviation disruption.
    • Recent scans show increased military flight activity (military aircraft detected).
  • Diplomacy & mediation
    • Pakistan acting as mediator between the sides on the pause — concrete channel, not just statements.
  • Information environment
    • Media and opinion pieces active; avoid tactical decisions based on unverified social posts.
  • 🟢 Good News
    • Framework with Lebanon may reduce direct frontline exchanges if implemented. Pakistan mediation keeps a negotiation channel open.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating risk — pause fragile and violations likely.

    • חיזבאללה מכריז שההסכם פסול ומאיים באי‑שקט פנימי. הערה טקטית: פעילות חיזבאללה יומית — סיכון לפיצוץ מקומי גבוה.

  • דיפלומטיה ותיווך
    • פקיסטן ממלאת תפקיד מתווך בין הצדדים — ערוץ מעשי וקונקרטי.

    • המסגרת עם לבנון יכולה להוריד מידיות קרבות אם תיושם. תיווך פקיסטני משאיר ערוץ לשיחות.
  • הערכת איום: הסלמה — הסיכוי להפרות גבוה ורגישות למעשים צבאיים.

Situation Report — Day 27 (last 6 hrs)

Active strikes: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iran; Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon; Iranian/Hezbollah missiles fired at Israel.
  • Diplomacy / Ceasefire: Trump announced a 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes until Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET, claiming talks and an Iranian request. Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating.
  • Context: First pause (5 days, Mar 23) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Northern Border (Lebanon): US-Israel-Lebanon framework signed tying a ceasefire to Hezbollah disarmament. Hezbollah rejects the deal, calls it null; leaders warn of internal unrest. IDF struck targets in south Lebanon; Reuters reports an Israeli drone strike there day after the deal.
  • Strait of Hormuz: Fine-print disputes continue between US, Iran and Oman. Iran publicly allows passage for Russia, India, China while restricting others. IRGC rebuffed US hotline.
  • Gaza & South: IDF reports killing Wadi Haniyeh, nephew of Ismail Haniyeh. An Israeli drone strike killed a young girl in a Gaza “safe zone” (civilian casualty reported).
  • Airspace & Logistics: Regional airports closed: Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan. Flight-scan activity limited; a few military tracks observed.
  • Information & Security: Increased internet censorship in Iran post-conflict. Hamas restricts protests and phones in Gaza.
  • International action: Pakistan mediating; no new major troop deployments reported.
  • 🟢 Good News: 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes announced; US-Israel-Lebanon framework signed (ceasefire tied to disarmament).
Threat assessment: Escalating

Situation Report — Day 27

  • Active strikes/sirens: Ongoing US/Israeli airstrikes inside Iran today. Iran, Hezbollah and Hamas continue missile/rocket strikes on Israel. Northern border exchanges occur daily.
  • Pause / diplomacy: Trump announced a SECOND pause on Iran energy strikes — 10 days, until Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET — claiming an Iranian request. Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. Previous 5-day pause was violated within hours by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Israel–Lebanon framework: US-Israel-Lebanon deal signed tying ceasefire to Hezbollah disarmament. Netanyahu calls it a strategic blow to Iran/Hezbollah. Hezbollah rejects the deal and labels it null; allied groups threaten instability. IDF struck targets in southern Lebanon after the agreement. Reuters and others report Israeli drone strike in southern Lebanon today.
  • Northern Border tactical note: Daily Hezbollah fire continues. IDF reports targeted strikes against operatives in south Lebanon. First time in this phase the framework deal coincided with immediate cross-border strikes.
  • Iran internal / messaging: Tehran accuses US of violating the memorandum; IRGC rebuffed US Strait-of-Hormuz hotline. Post-war internet controls and greater censorship reported.
  • Strait of Hormuz / shipping:
  • — Iran allows passage for select 'friendly' states (Russia, India, China) while restricting others. Negotiations on Hormuz deal fine print continue; Oman involved in talks.
  • Gaza front:
  • — Israeli drone strike killed a young girl in a Gaza declared safe zone. Hamas has tightened security and suppressed planned protests in Gaza.
  • Key targeted kills: IDF says it killed Wadi Haniyeh, nephew of Ismail Haniyeh.
  • Airspace / civil impact: Regional airports remain closed across Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan. Flight traffic reduced; military flights tracked in the region.
  • Other military tech: Russia claims domestic strike-UAV industry growth — signals more proliferated drone threats region-wide.
  • 🟢 Good News: A negotiated pause window and the Israel–Lebanon framework create openings for de-escalation and a tied path to Hezbollah disarmament.
  • Threat assessment: Volatile — overall situation trending toward escalation despite diplomatic openings.

Note: the first 5‑day pause (Mar 23) was violated within hours by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Air & civil status: Regional airports largely closed; commercial traffic sharply reduced. Flight scans show limited military sorties.

  • 🟢 Good News: Framework deal with Lebanon signed (potential pressure on Hezbollah); IDF reports a high‑value target neutralized.

  • גבול צפוני: התקפות יומיות של חיזבאללה ותקיפות ישראליות בדרום לבנון. הוסכם מתווה ישראל–לבנון; חיזבאללה מכריז על בטלות ואיים בהסלמה. דיווחי רויטרס וצה"ל מדווחים על תקיפות ומטוסים בלתי מאוישים בדרום לבנון אחרי ההסכם.
  • מיצר הורמוז: איראן מותירה מעבר לספינות ידידותיות (רוסיה, הודו, סין) וחוסמת אחרות. משמרות מהפכה דחו קו חם אמריקאי. עוד מחלוקות על הפרטים הטכניים של ההסדר.

  • מעמד אווירי ואזרחי: נמלי תעופה אזוריים סגורים ברובם; תנועה אזרחית מצומצמת. סריקות טיסות מצביעות על טיסות צבאיות בודדות.
  • הקשר טקטי: איראן משתמשת בגישה סלקטיבית למים כאמצעי לחץ. המתווה קושר הפסקת אש לפירוז חיזבאללה — קשה לאכיפה. צה"ל מדווח על חיסול ודי חנייה (וודי חנייאה), הישג טקטי.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: מתווה עם לבנון נחתם (לחץ על חיזבאללה); צה"ל מדווח על חיסול יעד בכיר.
  • הערכת איומים: במגמת הסלמה.
